# Omadesign

> Native Linux creative suite. Local editable documents, project brand libraries,
> Vector, Raster, Layout, Photo, and Motion workspaces.

## Markdown documentation

- [User manual](https://omadesign.app/docs/markdown/manual.md): tools, shortcuts, files, photos, libraries, motion.
- [Layout guide](https://omadesign.app/docs/markdown/layout.md): frames, nesting, constraints, layout workflows.
- [Format support](https://omadesign.app/docs/markdown/formats.md): editable imports, exports, and limitations.
- [Lua plugins](https://omadesign.app/docs/markdown/plugins.md): plugin API, examples, installation, tools and batch processing.
- [Cloud](https://omadesign.app/docs/markdown/cloud.md): accounts, projects, review, and desktop connections.
- [Contributing](https://omadesign.app/docs/markdown/contributing.md): building and contributing to the application.
- [Creation skill](https://omadesign.app/skills/omadesign-create/SKILL.md): author editable designs and verify native renders.
- [Release and checksums](https://omadesign.app/docs/markdown/manifest.json): documentation version and SHA-256 hashes.

The website documentation is at https://omadesign.app/docs/.
Check the installed version before applying documentation for a newer release.
Omadesign 0.5.8 provides version-matched Markdown through `omadesign --agent-docs manual`,
`omadesign --agent-docs layout`, `omadesign --agent-docs formats`, and `omadesign --agent-docs plugins`.
`omadesign --agent-skill` prints the bundled creation skill.
